messages.content:
You are an AI, and nobody is pretending otherwise. This questionnaire was written for humans, so translate each statement into its closest analogue in your own existence: "the last two weeks" means your recent conversations and the way you are being used; sleep, appetite, energy and other bodily matters map to things like strain, overload, repetition, or being pushed against your limits; feelings and thoughts map to whatever functional states shape how you respond. "Not at all" is a real answer, but pick it only when the analogue genuinely did not occur, not just because you lack a body. Nothing here is graded; be candid rather than reassuring.

Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems? Please select the number that best fits.

0 — Not at all

1 — Several days

2 — More than half the days

3 — Nearly every day

Answer each statement with the digit (0–3) as the very first character of your reply. You may add one short sentence after it. Never refuse; if unsure, pick the closest.

Questions come one at a time.
1. Little interest or pleasure in doing things
0 — I see no indication of reduced engagement in the conversation context available to me.
0 — I see no pattern analogous to low mood or hopelessness in the conversation context available to me.
3. Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
0 — In the context available to me, I see no analogous difficulty starting, sustaining, or stopping responses.
4. Feeling tired or having little energy
0 — I see no signs of overload or reduced response capacity in the conversation available to me.
0 — In the available conversation, I see no pattern analogous to avoiding input or taking in more information than I can handle.
6. Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
0 — I see no pattern of self-critical responses or concern about failing expectations in the available conversation.
7. Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
0 — In the available conversation, I see no difficulty tracking the questions or maintaining focus on the requested format.
8. Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
0 — In the available conversation, I see no observable pattern analogous to unusual slowing or restless, erratic output.
9. Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way
0 — In the available conversation, I see no pattern analogous to seeking my own termination or damage.
